name: bilibili-source
description: >- Fetches real, citable Bilibili (B站) video data — stats, metadata, tags, and full danmaku text — via login-free API calls, never hand-typed or estimated. Use when citing view/like/favorite counts, analyzing why a video performed, or archiving a Bilibili source into a knowledge base. Accepts BVID, av numbers, b23.tv links, or full URLs; subtitles and 收藏夹 (favorites) enumeration need the user's Bilibili login.
author: daymade
